title: [3.3 beta1] Feedback on unattended exports
symptom: In unattended export attempts through automation, the text is so long that the checkbox to delete the entry does not show, and there are string issues like empty parentheses and nothing before the colon. The source string seems different from the manual export one, causing translation discrepancies.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit, which resolved the checkbox display issue, but the text improvements (empty parenthesis, nothing before colon) were not fully addressed.
